title: weekly_signups.sql

spec.text: Weekly signups per acquisition channel for the last 8 full weeks (Monday to Sunday, current week excluded) for the marketing dashboard. Users with no channel are counted as 'unknown'.

context: PostgreSQL 16. users.id is the primary key and users.created_at is timestamptz; the reporting role's session TimeZone is UTC and the dashboard shows UTC weeks. user_profiles has exactly one row per user (user_id is its primary key). The dashboard fills in weeks that have no rows.

files.content:
SELECT
    date_trunc('week', u.created_at)::date AS week_start,
    COALESCE(u.channel, 'unknown') AS channel,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS signups
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - INTERVAL '8 weeks'
  AND u.created_at < date_trunc('week', now())
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC;
